summary: A mixed legal and retail day. Karnataka HC stays forgery case against cult.fit co-founder Rishabh Telang; India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030; Reliance planning $1 billion securitization deal.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court stays forgery case against cult.fit co-founder Rishabh Telang.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030, up from current levels.
India's home and household market to reach USD 260 billion by 2030; durables category rising from USD 66 billion (2025) to USD 95 billion (2030).
Reliance lines up $1 billion bond sale, its second securitization in three weeks.
Zigly targets ₹100 crore revenue by FY 2026-27, adding 60 vet-care centres and pursuing acquisitions.
